Zamine_Clique_desc_0.value: Edi Zamine rules his fiefdom of Wadang with an Iron Hoof tipped with Steel Talons. \n\nAny amount of dissent is silenced, quickly and even if it is allowed to fester, it's usually used to justify a crackdown. This leads to Wadang pretty much being a failed state within the Beakavian Assembly that is only functioning by fueling racial tensions and §Raspirations of conquest§.

G_Z_Divide_NS_desc.value: If it's not obvious at a glance, Griffons are not native to this land. \\\\n\\\\nBefore the arrival of Griffonian Adventurer Alexey de Ulytrice, the Zebrides were an archipeligo of uncontacted Zebraic tribes all practicing different languages and customs. \\\\n\\\\nIt was easy for the Griffons to establish the City of Beakavia and posture themselves as rulers over the natives. That being said, the Government is blatantly Griffonian-Centric and laws of the Governate discriminate against Zebras on all levels. \\\\n\\\\nThis will need to be addressed, and soon.

YAN_core_last_stand.value: The True Reality of Modern Warfare

YAN_core_last_stand_desc.value: Reliance on Beakavia let the Natives not have to worry about internal rivalries. But with no established structures, and against an opponent with modern weapons - the Natives here are easily falling to radical ... and militant solutions.

alone_and_confused_Radical_desc.value: Rising up in response to the recent privatization by the VOC, the Natives of the Island have risen in defiance and demand to control their own future. If these rebellions are not quashed soon, they may garner international sympathy.

dip_isolation_Radical_desc.value: The Natives of the Island have never needed anything more than their island and their peoples. The Griffische were the ones to open them up to the world, and without the assistance of Beakavia, the Zebras here are completely isolated from the outside world.

faith_in_isaac_desc.value: todo, the native yaneons know that the only reason their rights have been respected has been the current leader, who is soft, once he goes, chaos will ensue

home_advantage_radical_desc.value: The Natives have lived in here for hundreds of years, what they lack in technology they make up for in knowledge of the land and a cohesive tribal familial spirit. Displacing them will be difficult without use of modern technologies.

language_issue_NS_desc.value: #todo - government has to produce decrees in three languages

zebrides_mission_desc.value: #todo - country has three racial divides, Griffische, loyal Griffons to Griffonia, Zebrikaans, loyal to Zebrikaaners (Griffons that are cultural mix but racially Griffon) and Yaneoan, Native Zebras to the islands.

VOC_Base_Shareholders_desc.value: The Vereenigde Oost-Griffische Compagnie was founded on the principle that Capital is the be all, end all of all discussion. \\\\n\\\\nRun by multiple families with inherited fortunes, many of them choose to live back in Griffonia Proper rather than on the Island. This results in a capital outflow that is worrying many of the VOC Administrators. Many of them propose simply severing the contract and going it out alone, but being currently reliant on supply ships from Skyfall and Feathisia makes this prospect seem almost like a death wish.

VOC_Base_Mercs_desc.value: The Company has no Armed Forces of any kind, all permanent residents of the Island are 'Employees' and their servants. So in order to keep order, Mercenaries function as a solution. \\\\n\\\\n§RFor now.§!

VOC_Base_Aspirations_desc.value: Much to the dismay of neighbouring nations, the VOC is a profiteering nation and they know how to secure a good trade. Often they will be seen blatantly selling weapons to both sides of a civil war, but you don't shoot the salesman, §Hbecause without them, you can't kill your enemies.§!

Zamine_Idea_1_desc.value: §HZebrikaaner Instructors§! 'assist' the Military Junta of Edi Zamine. But in reality, they are either spies filtering information back to the Central Government of Beakavia or engaging in blatant corruption. Resulting in a generally better army overall, but not as effective as it could be.

Zamine_Idea_2_desc.value: The Natives here are being blatantly exploited by their overall ruler, often ignoring directives from Beakavia regarding their behaviour. Quite simply. §RThe Weak Should Make Way For The Strong.§

CER_Idea_1_desc.value: Ceram has avoided much controversy in Beakavian Politics due to it's relatively friendly people. However, this naivety has led to shady figures taking an interest.

MIZ_Idea_1_desc.value: Due to the obsession of Admiral Ewal, many of the Natives under his §R'Care'§! have been forced into Naval Service of what is pretty much, a Pirate Fleet but unofficially responsible for protecting trade routes. He maintains an iron hoof over all matters of the Sea and the lives of his motley crew.

Hospitaller_Idea_1_desc.value: The Griffons of the Order see themselves as protectors of the innocent. Be it a Zebra, Griff or Giraffe they will patrol the coasts with their meagre fleet and take in any refugees. Often recruiting them as auxilaries for further incursions or merely acting in charity. \\\\n\\\\nThis of course means there is virtually no industry or agriculture on the island to speak of, as the entire land is devoted to this goal. So the Order is entirely reliant on it's benefactors in Beakavia.

Cleo_Idea_1.value: The Healer Mother of the Pulapi

Cleo_Idea_1_desc.value: Cleo is seen as a Mother of her people, having been the one to routinely negotiate with Beakavia regarding their autonomy, she is a guiding voice and will never ask others to do something she would not do herself.

Cleo_Idea_2_desc.value: Cleo has received priority support from the Central Government of Beakavia, which has helped her maintain her position and influence.

security_forces_snubbed.value: Our recent decision to choose temporary economic surplus as opposed to bolstering out security forces has left our Mercenary Captains feeling alienated.

Sociopath_trait_desc.value: A persistent lack of empathy or guilt, they may be seen by others as Charismatic and Intelligent, but underneath they will stop at nothing to achieve their goals, regardless of the consequences or misery of others.

Zebrikaaner_nationality_desc.value: Zebrikaaner's are Griffon expats that have through many generations garnered a connection to the lands of the Zebrides and no longer see themselves as culturally similar to the mother country. Zebrikaaners are known for their desire for a Zebrikaaner society based on self-reliance and a strong militaristic ability.

caring_claw_desc.value: governor isaac is, while an imperial loyalist, a very soft and caring governor, very kind to natives. which upsets the radicals.

concessionary_sov_desc.value:
Concessionary Sovereignty - The Land is Governed by the §OBoard of Directors of the Vereenigde Oost-Griffische Compagnie§! §HVOC§!, a Conglomerate of privately owned corporations investing in the idea of vast foreign riches to saturate home markets. 

As the Government here is entirely absent and has no profit incentive to increase living standards or provide basic necessities - The Lands are split §Runder the control of Local Warlords§!, usually formerly Tribal Chiefs, that are too busy fighting each other for the bare necessities than to expel their oppressors. 

The §OVOC§! has a vested interest in ensuring the §RStatus Quo Remains§!. And is more than willing to use §RAny Means Necessary§!.

benign_paternalism_desc.value: Benign Paternalism - The Country is controlled by a jovial, respected and admired Governer who truly wants the best for the citizens under their watch. They interfere as little as possible and are often given credit for things they had no part or cause in. \n\nSegregation and Inequality is ignored as social issues not out of a desire for guarding conservative virtues but to instead not rock the boat, perse.

warlord_militarism_desc.value: Warlord Militarism - There is no Government, no Law and no Justice except for that which is decreed by the General, Supreme Commander or Warchief that leads a roving band of what is pretty much organized bandits claiming to fight for Ethnic Liberation, Social Change or against Oppressors.

garrison_state_desc.value: The Land is in a usually temporary, state of Military Control under the authority of a ruling Generalship that's ultimate goal is to control the territory on behalf of a foreign Military Structure. The lawlessness created by this state of affairs is usually responded to with citizens resorting to banditry to make ends meet with reprisals in response being over-reaching and brutal.
